review:
After playing CRSED: F.O.A.D., I can honestly say it’s one of the most unique battle royale experiences out there. The mix of realistic gunplay with supernatural abilities creates a kind of chaos that you just don’t get in games like PUBG or Fortnite. Every match feels unpredictable, and that’s part of the fun.

I really enjoyed the variety of weapons, vehicles, and the dark atmosphere of the maps — it gives the game its own identity. It’s fast, crazy, and full of those “what just happened?” moments that make you want to keep playing.

That said, I also get why some players feel like the game lost its direction over time. Some of the newer additions feel a bit weird or unnecessary, and matchmaking can be slow, probably because the player base isn’t as big as it used to be.

Still, despite its flaws, CRSED remains an underrated free-to-play shooter. If you’re looking for something different, chaotic, and just fun in a weird way, this game is definitely worth trying.
Super fun game to play a quick session after work!
